summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for $4.25bn of senior unsecured notes: $1.75bn 5.819% fixed-to-floating notes due 2032 and $2.50bn 6.262% fixed-to-floating notes due 2037. Coupons are fixed semi-annually until November 2031 and November 2036 respectively, then switch to compounded SOFR plus 1.310% and 1.660%. Notes issue November 3, 2026 under a forty-second supplemental indenture. Callable via make-whole, then par call. This is ordinary bank funding, not a special situation; there is no equity or deal term to arbitrage.
